items.title: AI workflow orchestration moves from experiments to operating routines
items.summary: Teams are standardizing repeatable AI workflows instead of running one-off prompts, creating demand for dashboards, decision queues, and operator memory.
rationale: High business leverage for recurring research and reporting loops
Maps directly to operator dashboards and queue management
Useful for AI operations and solutions engineering interviews

operator.notes: Build this into the command center view first.
operator.next_action: Turn the weekly signal review into a dashboard tab with decision states.

items.title: SQL quality checks become table stakes for analytics automation
items.summary: Analytics teams are adding automated checks for duplicate rows, missing fields, stale extracts, and KPI drift before reports reach stakeholders.
rationale: Strong fit for data analytics and BI portfolio positioning
Connects automation to measurable reporting reliability
Can become a reusable quality gate for weekly operations reports

operator.notes: Prototype against the operations reporting sample dataset.
operator.next_action: Add a data quality checklist and failing-row export to the reporting workflow.

items.title: Lead research workflows shift toward human-in-the-loop automation
items.summary: Sales operations teams are using automation to enrich accounts, prioritize outreach, and keep humans focused on judgment calls.
rationale: Supports CRM and solutions engineering story
Shows automation judgment without fully automating sensitive outreach
Pairs well with pipeline scoring dashboards

operator.notes: Keep this tied to analytics and prioritization, not spam automation.
operator.next_action: Track whether the CRM demo needs an enrichment or next-best-action view.

items.title: Benchmarking AI assistants needs repeatable tasks, not vibes
items.summary: Teams are comparing AI tools using repeatable tasks, defined success criteria, and notes on where each tool is strongest.
rationale: Turns tool comparison into an evidence-based workflow
Creates reusable portfolio proof for automation roles

operator.notes: Keep the benchmark lightweight and focused on real workflows.
operator.next_action: Run one task through the benchmark pack and record a scored result.

items.title: Raw AI news summaries create more noise than decisions
items.summary: Generic summaries can be useful for awareness, but they rarely explain which workflow should change next.
rationale: Useful contrast for the repo's decision-first positioning
Lower implementation value than workflow-specific signals
Good candidate for archive unless tied to a concrete project

operator.notes: Archive unless a future item ties this to a concrete workflow change.

mini_projects.title: Weekly AI Ops Command Center
mini_projects.why_now: The strongest signal is the need to convert AI tooling noise into a weekly decision routine.
mini_projects.build_scope: Add a dashboard view that shows signal status, next action, linked project, and weekly summary metrics.
mini_projects.success_metric: A reviewer can understand the weekly AI operations workflow in under one minute.
mini_projects.prompt_seed: Design a weekly AI operations review that turns ranked signals into watch, test, implement, and archive decisions.

mini_projects.title: Analytics Quality Alert Pack
mini_projects.why_now: The analytics signal shows clear value in preventing bad rows and stale metrics from reaching stakeholders.
mini_projects.build_scope: Create checks for duplicate records, missing KPI fields, stale dates, and unexpected metric shifts.
mini_projects.success_metric: The reporting workflow outputs both the dashboard and a clear data quality exception list.
mini_projects.prompt_seed: Build a lightweight quality gate for an operations reporting pipeline before generating stakeholder dashboards.

mini_projects.title: Lead Research Automation Brief
mini_projects.why_now: Sales operations workflows benefit from automation when they preserve human review and prioritization.
mini_projects.build_scope: Add a sample next-best-action table for CRM leads using score, stage, risk, and recommended follow-up.
mini_projects.success_metric: A sales ops reviewer can see which leads need action and why.
mini_projects.prompt_seed: Create a human-in-the-loop CRM prioritization workflow that explains recommended next actions.
